tagline: Creative technologist — building things that survive outside the demo room.
profile: As an XR developer I've contributed with a lot of enthusiasm to projects across AR, VR, mobile games and interactive installations. Connecting the virtual and physical world — and my drive to explore the edges of what technology can do — are central to my work. Every project is another chance to give people a fresh perspective.

education.note: Studied game development across individual and group projects: games, web applications, interactive installations and 3D. For my graduation project I researched AR-framework compatibility through cloud anchors and built my own framework integrating ARCore and ARKit — before ARFoundation existed.
Led a team building an indie game telling the story of the Sámi, the last tribe of Europe — guiding the project through every round and winning first place for the year.

offTheClock: Music production, baking, cooking, history, fitness
